name: Data.piIdele_spec
summary: The three parts of IsSplitSquarefree: the norm, the valuations, and the conjugates.

steps.claim: Prove the three parts of IsSplitSquarefree(piPlaces(D), N(D), piIdele(D)).
steps.lean:
lemma piIdele_spec : IsSplitSquarefree D.piPlaces D.N D.piIdele := ⟨by simp [piIdele, ← map_mul,
  ← coe_star_ringOfIntegers, π_mul_star], (⟨by split <;> erw [v_algebraMap_eq_intValuation] <;>
  simp_all [piPlaces, intValuation_pi], D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.star_notMem ·⟩)⟩

steps.claim: N(D) = piIdele(D) conj(piIdele(D)): the product is the principal idele of pi(D) conj(pi(D)) = N(D).

For every finite place w, the valuation of the w-component of piIdele(D) is exp(-1) if w divides pi(D) (w in piPlaces(D)) and 1 otherwise: the w-adic valuation of the integer pi(D) (multiplicative notation, exp(-1) being the element of the multiplicatively written value group Z^m0 (WithZero (Multiplicative Z)) that marks a uniformiser, not the real number 1/e; additively, ord_w = 1 on piPlaces(D) and 0 off it).
If w is in piPlaces(D), its conjugate is not.
